propositions: CodeReviewBatchRunner currently iterates only static req.criteria and stamps findings with reviewer_id but no logical criterion id, causing activated project criteria to never enter Round A/B
Project criteria must execute exactly once in Round A only, not in Round B, with findings tagged with logical criterion_id and preserved model-emitted criteria tags
An activated LLM-tier project criterion with a missing or malformed prompt must raise a located LLMError naming the criterion and expected prompt path
The runner must select active project.* criteria from registry.effective_criteria whose routing entry has exec: LLM and resolve each prompt using criterion_prompt_id before constructing batch entries
Round-A-only branch logic is stateless and testable, using the stable YAML step_id without mutable seen-sets to ensure deterministic retries and replays
